app.tagline: Photograph a leaf. Get advice in your language, with no internet.

auth.subtitleLogin: Log in to scan your crops and keep your history on this phone.
auth.subtitleCreate: Create a free account to scan your crops and keep your history on this phone.
auth.name: Full name
auth.privacy: Your account is stored only on this phone.

errors.name: Enter your name (2 to 60 characters).
errors.exists: This mobile number already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Wait 30 seconds and try again.

home.noScans: No scans yet. Scan your first leaf.

scan.title: Crop Disease Scanner
scan.hint: Hold the leaf steady inside the frame
scan.tip: Use daylight and fill most of the frame with one leaf.

result.title: AI Confidence
result.retake: The photo is not clear enough. Please take another one.
result.notCrop: This does not look like a crop leaf or an insect. Please photograph one leaf or insect, close up and in good light.
result.healthy: No disease found on this leaf.

advisory.title: Advice
advisory.dosageMissing: No approved dosage is available for this case. Ask your extension officer.
advisory.fallback: This is a safe standard answer. Ask your extension officer for treatment advice.
advisory.refusal: This request cannot be answered with product advice.
advisory.englishOnly: This advice is available in English only for now.

history.title: Diagnosis History
history.noAdvice: No advice was saved for this scan. Scan the leaf again to get advice.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.invalidArea: Enter a size above 0 and up to 1000.
account.privacyNote: Your account and scan history are stored in a SQLite database on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
account.deleteHelp: This removes your account and all scans from this phone. Enter your password to confirm.

about.title: About
about.text: Redesigned Edge AI recognises crop problems from a leaf photo and gives advice without internet. Photos never leave the phone.

errors.busy: The device is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.rejected: That photo could not be used. Try a different photo.
errors.invalid: Some of the details are not valid.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: The language model runs only in the Android app. It is not available in the browser.
errors.llm: The chat model could not run on this phone. Details: {{detail}}

chat.title: Ask AgriEdge
chat.intro: Ask a farming question. Answers come from the language model on this phone and can be wrong. For doses, scan the leaf and use Advice.
chat.s1: How do I stop leaf spots on tomato?
chat.s2: When should I water tomato plants?
chat.s3: How do I keep insects away without spraying?
chat.followUpHint: Ask a follow-up question about this leaf. Answers come from the language model on this phone.
